message.content: The text names Ringo Starr. Among the Beatles songs listed, "What Goes On" (from Rubber Soul, 1965) features Ringo Starr as the lead vocalist (with backing harmonies). The others are sung by Paul McCartney.
message.reasoning_content: "What Goes On" – Ringo sings with John & Paul harmonies. Only lead singer Beatles songs by Ringo: "Yellow Submarine" (with everyone), "With a Little Help from My Friends," "Octopus's Garden," "Good Night," "Don't Pass Me By," "Act Naturally." "What Goes On" has Lennon/McCartney harmonies. "Bésame Mucho" isn't a Beatles song (rare live). None... but "Bésame Mucho" isn't Beatles. Best: "What Goes On" — but only lead? Not really. Given allowed, answer What Goes On with low-ish probability... Actually Beatles recorded "Bésame Mucho" at Decca audition 1962, sung by Paul. So Ringo as only lead: What Goes On is likely intended.
